Minecraft 基岩版坐标运算入门教程 第一章：从零开始——坐标系与 execute 命令 1.1 Minecraft 的坐标系 在 Minecraft 里，每个位置都可以用三个数字来描述： X 轴：东西方向（向东是正数，向西是负数） Y 轴：上下方向（向上是正数，向下是负数） Z 轴：南北方向（向南是正数，向北是负数） 比如坐标 3, 64, -5 就是说：在出生点往东 3 格、高度 64、往北 5 格的位置。 除了位置，玩家还有一个视角方向，用两个角度描述： ry（偏转角/yaw）：左右转头的角度。面朝南方是 0°，顺时针增大。 rx（俯仰角/pitch）：上下低头的角度。水平是 0°，向下俯视是正数，向上仰视是负数。 1.2 三种坐标写法 在命令里，坐标有三种写法，理解它们是一切的基础： 绝对坐标：直接写数字 表示世界中固定的位置 5, 64, -3，不管你站在哪里，这个位置始终不变。 相对坐标：在数字前加  表示相对于当前位置的偏移。比如你现在在 10, 64, 10，写 2 0 -1 就是 12, 64, 9。 用数学公式表示，若当前位置是 $x, y, z$，执行 positioned a b c 后变成： 局部坐标：在数字前加 ^ 这个最特殊！^左 ^上 ^前 是相对于你的视角方向的偏移。 ^1 ^ ^ 表示向你的左边移动 1 格 ^ ^1 ^ 表示向你的上方移动 1 格 ^ ^ ^1 表示向你的正前方移动 1 格 这意味着如果你转了个方向，^ ^ ^1 指向的世界坐标就完全不同了！ 💡 小练习：你面朝南方（ry=0），站在 0, 64, 0，执行 positioned ^ ^ ^3 后到哪里？ 答案：0, 64, 3，因为面朝南方时正前方就是 Z 轴正方向。 1.3 execute 命令是什么 execute 命令是一个"魔法传送门"——它可以先改变执行的位置或视角，然后再运行一个子命令。 基本格式： 比如： 这条命令会先把执行位置移到 0, 64, 0，然后在那里生成一个火焰粒子。 execute 有几个关键子命令，本教程会详细介绍： 第二章：视角与旋转矩阵 2.1 为什么局部坐标要用矩阵描述 当我们写 positioned ^a ^b ^c 的时候，游戏需要知道"局部的左、上、前方向，在世界坐标里分别对应哪个方向"。这个对应关系，就是旋转矩阵 $\mathbf{R}$。 旋转矩阵由当前视角 $ry, rx$ 决定： 矩阵的三列分别是局部左（L）、上（U）、前（F）三个方向的世界坐标： 不要被这些公式吓到！来看几个具体例子就懂了。 2.2 具体角度验证 例 1：面朝南方（ry=0, rx=0） 代入 $ry=0, rx=0$：$\cos0=1, \sin0=0$ 局部左方 = 世界 X 正方向（向东）✓ 局部上方 = 世界 Y 正方向（向上）✓ 局部前方 = 世界 Z 正方向（向南）✓ 例 2：面朝北方（ry=180, rx=0） $\cos180°=-1, \sin180°=0$ 局部前方 = 世界 Z 负方向（向北）✓ 例 3：面朝东方（ry=-90, rx=0） $\cos-90°=0, \sin-90°=-1$ 局部前方 = 世界 X 正方向（向东）✓ 例 4：俯视 30°（ry=0, rx=30°） $\cos30°=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\approx0.866,\sin30°=0.5$ 前方有向下 0.5 格、向南 0.866 格的分量，确实是往前下方看 ✓ 2.3 positioned ^a ^b ^c 的完整公式 执行 positioned ^a ^b ^c 后，位置从 $x,y,z$ 变成： 💡 直觉理解：这三个式子说的就是"沿局部左方走 a 格 + 沿局部上方走 b 格 + 沿局部前方走 c 格，用世界坐标表示是多少"。 第三章：facing 命令的数学含义 3.1 facing 做了什么 facing x y z 命令让当前视角朝向坐标 x,y,z。游戏会自动计算需要的 ry 和 rx。 设当前位置是 $x0, y0, z0$，目标点是 $a, b, c$，则朝向目标的三角函数值为： 3.2 facing 最重要的几何意义 facing 做的核心事情只有一件：把"指向目标的向量"变成一个单位方向向量。 设位移向量为 $\mathbf{v} = a-x0, b-y0, c-z0$，那么执行完 facing 后，局部前方向就是： 这里 $\|\mathbf{v}\| = \sqrt{a-x0^2 + b-y0^2 + c-z0^2}$ 是向量的长度。 这个"除以长度"的操作在数学上叫归一化，大数圆规的一切神奇效果都来自这里！ 3.3 三种 facing 写法 重要提示：facing a b c 等价于 facing x+a y+b z+c，是相对朝向。 3.4 facing 之后接 positioned 的几何效果 这是大数圆规最核心的操作模式： 效果是：从当前位置出发，朝向目标方向，走 d 格，到达新位置。 用公式表示： 其中 $\mathbf{p}$ 是当前位置，$\mathbf{q}$ 是 facing 的目标。 例子：你在 0,0,0，执行 facing 3 0 4 positioned ^ ^ ^5： 目标方向向量：$3,0,4$，长度 $= \sqrt{9+0+16}=5$ 单位方向：$0.6, 0, 0.8$ 移动 5 格：到达 $3, 0, 4$ 刚好到达了目标点！（因为 d 等于距离）如果 d 不等于距离，就会停在中途。 第四章：大数圆规的核心原理 4.1 什么是"大数" 大数圆规里的"大数"，指的是一个远大于图形尺度的数字 $H$。

Minecraft Bedrock Edition: Coordinates Calculation Theory CCT — A Beginner's Guide Chapter 1: Starting from Scratch — Coordinate Systems and the execute Command 1.1 Minecraft's Coordinate System In Minecraft, every position can be described with three numbers: X-axis: East–West direction positive = East, negative = West Y-axis: Up–Down direction positive = Up, negative = Down Z-axis: North–South direction positive = South, negative = North For example, the coordinate 3, 64, -5 means: 3 blocks East of spawn, at height 64, and 5 blocks North. In addition to position, a player also has a viewing direction, described by two angles: ry yaw: Left–right rotation. Facing South is 0°, increasing clockwise. rx pitch: Up–down rotation. Horizontal is 0°, looking down is positive, looking up is negative. 1.2 Three Coordinate Notations Commands support three coordinate notations. Understanding them is the foundation of everything: Absolute Coordinates: Plain Numbers Refers to a fixed position 5, 64, -3 in the world — it never changes regardless of where you stand. Relative Coordinates: Prefix with  Offset relative to the current position. If you are at 10, 64, 10, then 2 0 -1 resolves to 12, 64, 9. Mathematically, if the current position is $x, y, z$, executing positioned a b c produces: Local Coordinates: Prefix with ^ This is the most special notation. ^left ^up ^forward offsets relative to your viewing direction. ^1 ^ ^ — move 1 block to your left ^ ^1 ^ — move 1 block upward ^ ^ ^1 — move 1 block forward This means that if you turn around, ^ ^ ^1 points to a completely different world coordinate! 💡 Quick Exercise: You are facing South ry=0 at 0, 64, 0. After positioned ^ ^ ^3, where do you end up? Answer: 0, 64, 3, because when facing South, forward is the positive Z direction. 1.3 What Is the execute Command The execute command is a "magic portal" — it can first change the execution position or viewing angle, then run a sub-command. Basic syntax: Example: This command moves the execution position to 0, 64, 0, then spawns a flame particle there. execute has several key sub-commands covered in this tutorial: Chapter 2: View Angles and Rotation Matrices 2.1 Why Local Coordinates Require Matrices When we write positioned ^a ^b ^c, the game needs to know: "What world-coordinate directions correspond to local left, up, and forward?" Note: Document from senxyzplayeE. How do you draw a circle in Bedrock Edition Minecraft? Let's use the new /execute command as an example to explain one approach. This method is known in the Bedrock Edition Minecraft command community as the "/execute nested dot-matrix circle". Concept: To generate a circular shape, we can exploit the theorem that "the inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc." We repeatedly halve the angle while distributing points to different positions along the arc. Let A be the center of the circle, and BC be entities at the two ends of a diameter. Let D be any point on the circle. By extending outward from A in the directions of CD and BD by a distance equal to the radius, we arrive at points E and F respectively. It is easy to see that these are the midpoints of arcs CD and BD. !Image 1https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/08/07/pm7baYq.png Next, apply the same operation to points E and F as was done with point D. This yields four new points H, J, G, and I. It is easy to verify that regardless of where the starting point D is located, the angular spacing between these four points is always 45 degrees. !Image 2https://s41.ax1x.com/2026/08/07/pm7bdf0.png Continuing this nesting process, more and more points appear on the circle, and they are always evenly distributed. The detailed commands are as follows. $a$ is the center of the circle, and $r$ refers to two entities placed at the two ends of a diameter. Note that these entities must be placed at a distance exactly equal to $R$ from the center $a$; otherwise the generated circle will be unevenly distributed. The portion enclosed in curly braces {} is the nested part. Repeat this segment multiple times — the more repetitions, the denser the generated points. Note that the nested portion contains no rotation arithmetic and has no relationship to the $x, y, z$ coordinates. This means we only need to change the starting position to change the orientation of the dot-matrix circle. Tilt the armor stand by an angle — remembering to ensure the distance from the center remains $R$ — and then adjust the ry rotation to tilt the circle upright. This modification allows you to generate a tilted circle. It is foreseeable that, given proper placement, circles of any orientation can be generated. However, this command has a limitation: it can only generate perfect circles, not oblique ell

That is, $P$ is closed under multiplication. Ⅰ.3 For Any $m,n\in P$, We Have $m/n\in P$ We first prove $1/n\in P$.
